rows.title: Adult Workday
rows.body: Come on out for the next adult workday. As always, we will have food and drink.

rows.title: Stacy
rows.body: Stacy jumped right in before heading off for the summer, but we cannot wait until she returns. You didn't miss much here but a lot of heat, Stacy!

rows.title: Nursery Team
rows.role: We always have openings in the...
rows.body: Good music, good dirt, good company. The nursery crew turns cuttings and donated plants into the sales that help fund the park.

rows.title: Randy
rows.body: If you want to learn iNat, Randy is the one to go to. See the signs going up? That is all iNat photography that Randy combines with QR codes to info about the species. Ask him about it all.

rows.title: Franky and Randy
rows.role: Bright Futures High School Program, Wednesdays
rows.body: Franky & Randy lead a hands-on volunteer program that gives Bright Futures High School students a meaningful way to put in their three hours a week—digging in the dirt, clearing park debris, planting new additions, pitching in on office work, setting up for park events, and tackling the zillion odd chores that keep a botanical park running.

rows.title: Gardening & Nursery
rows.body: Planting, propagating, weeding, trimming, and yard cleanup. The hands-on core of what keeps the gardens the way they are. No experience needed.

rows.title: Education & Tours
rows.body: Help develop self-guided tours, assist with classes and workshops, and support field trips and family programs.

rows.title: Events & Community
rows.body: Plant sales, holiday events, fundraisers, art exhibits, cornhole tournaments, and family fun nights. If you enjoy working with people, this is a good place to start.

rows.title: Maintenance & Office
rows.body: Light carpentry, painting, pressure washing, repairs, filing, data entry, graphic design, and thank-you cards. The work that keeps everything running.

rows.title: Special Skills & Outreach
rows.body: Photography, social media, writing, baking for events, and representing the park at the Farmer's Market or the County Fair. If you have a skill we haven't listed, we probably need it.

rows.title: Karen
rows.body: Karen planned and planted the butterfly garden, trains new volunteers, wrangles field trips, shows up for events, and mentors our Bright Futures students. Mostly she just makes everyone around her better. If there's a job nobody's claimed, she's already three steps into it.

rows.title: Volunteer Orientation
rows.body: Want to volunteer? Come to our orientation to give you ideas how you can fit it in doing things you enjoy. There's plenty!

rows.title: Events Committee
rows.body: Plant sales, holiday lights, fundraisers, art shows, cornhole tournaments, family fun nights — if it draws a crowd, this crew built it. They handle the chaos so everyone else gets to enjoy the party. Many hands, light work, lots of laughs.

rows.title: Krystal
rows.body: Krystal gets the word out about our gardens — Chamber of Commerce mixers, Discover Bradenton events, manning the booth at the Public Market, and most recently selling 50/50 tickets at the Garden Party. Thanks for jumping in, Krystal. We appreciate you!

rows.title: Bill
rows.body: Bill is the guy who can build it and make it beautiful — like the butterfly garden trellis everyone stops to photograph. He also keeps our irrigation running so nothing goes thirsty in July. Hand him a problem and a tape measure and step back.
